content:
rachel_finance: FYI NebulaDynamics disputed INV-2026-1355. Invoice shows €9,500 but our system recorded USD 10120 after conversion. Customer says bank rejected the wire for wrong currency code.
marco_billing: saw the SWIFT return: reason "currency not allowed". Bank note: must receive EUR for SEPA/IBAN or use USD beneficiary with intermediary bank. 
jong_ops: webhook: `{"return_reason":"CUR_MISMATCH","tx":"wire_55687","amount_usd":10120,"amount_eur":9500,"ts":"2026-05-11T09:14:02Z"}`. Looks like beneficiary expected EUR but we sent USD.
isabel_sales: customer wants to pay in EUR to avoid FX losses but asked us to reissue invoice with EUR totals (they say they were quoted in EUR). They also asked to waive one late fee because bank returned funds.
laura_legal: legal note: we can accept EUR settlement but need a short amendment documenting currency, FX responsibilities, and a clause keeping collection rights if payment fails. I'll provide a fast template.
marco_billing: action options: 1) reissue invoice in EUR and accept SEPA/wire, 2) accept partial USD wire now and balance in EUR, 3) require customer to pay via card in USD (they prefer EUR). Any preferences?
rachel_finance: finance prefers option 1 if customer truly contracted in EUR. Otherwise take partial payment today to avoid service disruption. @isabel_sales confirm contract currency.
isabel_sales: contract PDF says pricing in EUR (section 2.1). Sales error on billing conversion. Customer emailed copy of signed contract.
jong_ops: tagging collections bot to pause dunning while we sort currency.
collections_bot: Action: invoice INV-2026-1355 status set to "currency_review_hold". Dunning paused until 2026-05-20.
marco_billing: i'll reissue a corrected invoice in EUR and send SEPA instructions with IBAN/SWIFT. bank details snippet: ```Account: Redwood Inference (EUR IBAN)
IBAN: GB33BUKB20201555555555
BIC/SWIFT: BUKBGB22
Reference: INV-2026-1355```
isabel_sales: customer asked for FX credit to cover bank fees and mid-market rate difference. they're asking for €120 credit. Laura, can we allow that?
laura_legal: legal ok to approve a goodwill FX credit up to €150 for customer retention, but must be documented and flagged as non-precedent. Add note: "goodwill FX credit applied" and attach signed acceptance.
rachel_finance: finance approves €120 credit conditional on signed amendment, not on future invoices. Marco please apply a credit memo and reissue total.
marco_billing: ledger snapshot queued: `account,invoice,orig_amt_eur,credit,status
NebulaDynamics,INV-2026-1355,9500,120,currency_hold`
isabel_sales: I called the CFO; they will initiate SEPA for the corrected EUR invoice and upload signed amendment. CFO asked that service remain uninterrupted while payment is pending.
jong_ops: confirm: no service cut as long as customer adheres to the agreed hold and uploads payment proof. logging action: SERVICE_CONTINUED by jong_ops at 2026-05-11T10:05Z.
marco_billing: sent corrected EUR invoice and amendment template: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/currency-amendment. requested proof of wire and ETA.
collections_bot: Reminder set: check_INV-2026-1355 on 2026-05-20.
isabel_sales: customer uploaded wire confirmation showing amount EUR 9,380 (after €120 credit) initiated 2026-05-12 08:34 CET. attached screenshot.
marco_billing: received SEPA settlement notification at 2026-05-13T07:22Z. posting PARTIAL_SETTLEMENT: EUR 9,380 credited. updating ledger: `NebulaDynamics,INV-2026-1355,9500,partial_paid_9380`
rachel_finance: closing note: remaining balance zero after credit. Mark invoice settled, apply credit memo, remove from watch. Great retention win.
collections_bot: Action: invoice INV-2026-1355 status set to "paid_settled".
marco_billing: posted final ledger export and closed AR ticket. closing ts 2031234899
